description: Source code implementing open addressing / linear probing hash map with functions for find, insert, rehash, iterate, clear, remove, and get operations, specific to Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_oa_lp_find
methods.description: Finds an entry in the hash map based on key and entry state filters.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_oa_lp_insert_no_rehash
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the hash map without triggering rehash.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_oa_lp_rehash
methods.description: Rehashes the hash map to resize buckets, re-inserting existing entries.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_oa_lp_iter_next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next used entry in the hash map.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_oa_lp_iter
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for the hash map.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_oa_lp_clear
methods.description: Clears all entries in the hash map, optionally calling a callback on each.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_oa_lp_insert
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair, triggering rehash if necessary.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_oa_lp_remove
methods.description: Removes an entry by key, marking it as a tombstone.

methods.name: sys_hashmap_oa_lp_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key if present.
